title: From Midnight Mystery to Snack CEO 🚚
topic: The resolution of the neighborhood snack empire and the secret scooter deliveries.

lines.speaker: mr_haque
lines.text: Nix, the authorities are here, and they found the hidden stash of spicy chips [beat] hidden right behind my garden shed!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Relax Mr. Haque [beat] those aren't authorities, that's just Ding and Joy coming to collect the final shipment of the season.

lines.speaker: lubna
lines.text: I knew you were up to something when I saw those scooter tracks [beat] leading straight to the grocery wholesaler at three AM!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Mom, you call it a grocery wholesaler, but I call it the headquarters [beat] where the Nix Snack Dynasty was officially born last night.

lines.speaker: sam
lines.text: I've been tracking your delivery routes for weeks [beat] and I am telling the principal you have turned the bus stop into a black market!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Tell whoever you want, Sam [beat] because even the principal is on my subscription list for those imported ramen packs you can't find anywhere.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: I don't care about your little business, Nix [beat] give me all the chocolate bars or I'm turning your precious scooter into scrap metal!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Actually Bruno, I just hired you [beat] check your locker, there is a uniform and a map of the north side deliveries waiting for you.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I have seen a lot of startups, but using a silent electric scooter [beat] to bypass the neighborhood curfew is actually quite brilliant, nephew.

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: He did not just bypass the curfew [beat] he negotiated a distribution deal with every teenager in a five-mile radius while we were sleeping.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Being the Snack CEO isn't about the sugar [beat] it is about the logistics of craving when every other store in town is closed.

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: He is actually doing it [beat] the little brat turned a midnight hobby into a full-blown empire right under our noses.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix turned a midnight secret into a snack dynasty [beat] proving that the right wheels and a little hustle can rule the streets.
